campaign_logline: In the Aurelia sector, your ship isn't yours; it is a leased asset in a system governed by debt-cycles and privatized air.
opening_situation: Player starts with a high-interest lien on their vessel. To keep flight privileges, they must accept contracts from Vanguard security to clear 'delinquent' cargo in the Zenith zone.
main_mystery: The truth behind why Aurelia’s infrastructure is owned by a shadowy consortium and who actually owns the 'debt' of the citizens.
act_1_outline: Negotiate with Vanguard to settle initial docking fees.
Recover stolen luxury components from pirate-held outposts.
Uncover the discrepancy between local law and corporate ownership.
long_term_reveal: The 'Debt' is a curated loop: some sectors are intentionally foreclosed to consolidate resources for a select group of elite shareholders.
kaelen_rule: Kaelen is publicly a broker; she manages contracts and settles debt disputes.
faction_reveal_rule: New factions are only revealed upon passing through jump gates to adjacent systems.
humor_rule: Dry, dark humor. No catchphrases or repeated jokes about 'space' tropes.
address_rule: NPCs address the player as 'Pilot', 'Contractor', or by their ship's registration ID.
fallback_rule: If data is missing, NPCs default to standard logistical updates regarding cargo and fuel costs.

story_arcs.name: The Foreclosure Path
story_arcs.summary: Investigate the legal loophole allowing Vanguard to seize ships from 'non-compliant' pilots in the Aurelia sector.

rumor_trails.name: Ghost Ledger
clue_templates: A recurring 'Admin Fee' that doesn't appear on the public manifest.
An encrypted log of a shipment that was never legally registered.
rumor_trails.payoff: Unlocks the 'Owner's Override' title and a unique hidden system core.

regeneration_triggers.description: Generate a new arc when the player completes the main primary narrative thread.

expansion_rules: No retconning of past choices; append new content to existing timelines.
New minerals and ship upgrades must appear only in newly accessible sectors.
